items.q: Andy Razof and J. C. Johnson. They collaborated.

ctx.x: Andy Razof and J. C. Johnson. They collaborated. They did a lot of those things. So he was trying to make it lighter on himself for -- you know, give him a break. And then he wrote -- another thing he wrote while he was in there, 'My Fate's in Your Hands.'
